# cloudsmith_organization (Data Source)

The `organization` data source allows fetching of metadata about a given Cloudsmith organization. The fetched data can be used to resolve permanent identifiers from an organization's user-facing name. These identifiers can then be passed to other resources to allow more consistent identification as user-facing names can change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_organization" "my_organization" {
  slug = "my-organization"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the organization in URIs.

### Read-Only

- `country` (String) Country in which the organization is based.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the organization was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location` (String) The city/town/area in which the organization is based.
- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the organization.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm immutably identifies the organization. It will never change once an organization has been created.
- `tagline` (String) A short public description for the organization.
